collection.label: Pyramid Texts of Unas
collection.critical_edition: Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae, ed. Doris Topmann (2018 data, AED-TEI)
collection.search_terms: pyramid texts unas unis wenis saqqara utterance spell osiris atum re horus seth cannibal hymn offering ritual serpent spells ascent sky
collection.description: The Pyramid Texts in the pyramid of Unas at Saqqara (c. 2350 BCE), the oldest Egyptian religious texts: all seventeen inscribed walls, utterance by utterance, with the TLA transliteration and Mercer's 1952 English, each section placed on its wall photograph by column number.

authors.name: Pyramid of Unas (royal funerary texts)
authors.bio: Unas, last king of the 5th Dynasty, was buried at Saqqara in the first pyramid whose inner walls carry the Pyramid Texts; the spells were compiled by priests from older rituals.
